blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Argument mining in full-text scholarly articles remains an important yet challenging task. This difficulty stems not only from the need to model long-distance dependencies but also from the substantial effort required to annotate sentence-level argumentative components throughout lengthy documents. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel approach that leverages scientific entity mentions (e.g., tasks, datasets, and models) to identify and structure claims in scholarly literature. We validate our approach through a case study involving 50 full-text research papers on sentiment analysis. We first establish a reliable human gold standard (Krippendorff's $α= 0.80$), identifying 113 claim-bearing sentences and extracting 199 structured claim records from 300 candidate sentences. To address the annotation bottleneck, we employ a majority-voting ensemble of large language models (LLMs) to generate a silver-standard dataset comprising 1,487 claims. Encoders fine-tuned exclusively on the silver-standard dataset outperform those trained on a small human-annotated gold-standard dataset and demonstrate strong zero-shot transfer to NLP papers outside the training corpus.
blocks.zh: 全文学术文章的论证仍然是一项重要而艰巨的任务。 这一困难不仅是因为需要模拟长途依赖关系,而且还因为需要作出大量努力,在整个冗长的文件中对句子层面的论证部分进行注释。 为了应对这些挑战,我们采用了一种新的方法,利用科学实体提及(例如,任务、数据集和模型)的机会,查明学术文献中的说法并加以结构。 我们通过一个案例研究验证我们的方法,其中涉及50份关于情绪分析的全文研究论文。 我们首先确定了可靠的人类金本位(Krippendorff的0.80美元),确定了113个含索赔的判决,并从300个候选判决中提取了199个结构化的索赔记录。 为了解决注释瓶颈问题,我们使用多数投票的大型语言模型(LLMS),生成包含1 487项索赔的银标准数据集。 完全根据银-标准数据集对编码器进行微调,超过了在小型人类附加说明的金-标准数据集上受训的编码器,并显示在培训大纲之外向NLP文件进行了有力的零发转接。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Scientific literature is a rich source of complex reasoning, making it a particularly relevant domain for scientific argument mining Teufel et al. (1999) ; Al Khatib (2021) .
The central objective of scientific argument mining (SAM) is to identify argumentative components and reconstruct their relations in scholarly texts Lawrence and Reed (2019) ; Al Khatib (2021) .
Scholarly text analysis often draws on established argumentation frameworks, such as Toulmin’s model Toulmin (1958) and Walton’s argumentation schemes Walton et al. (2008) , to identify claims, supporting evidence, and their argumentative relationships.
However, existing research has largely focused on abstracts or individual sections of scientific articles Accuosto and Saggion (2019) ; Mayer et al. (2020) ; Fergadis et al. (2021) ; Accuosto et al. (2021) .
One reason for this focus is the substantial effort required for full-text annotation, as illustrated by the Sci-Arg corpus Lauscher et al. (2018) .
Furthermore, identifying argumentative components and their relationships across entire documents poses substantial challenges for neural models Binder et al. (2022) .

科学论证挖掘(SAM)的中心目标是在学术著作"Lawrence and Reed" (2019)中确定论证成分并重建它们的关系; Al Khatib (2021).

blocks.en:
To address these two challenges, we draw on approaches from general-domain argument mining, particularly those applied to political discourse and social media, where arguments are often identified in relation to specific controversial topics Levy et al. (2018) ; Ein-Dor et al. (2020) ; Verma et al. (2026) .
In these domains, topics serve as semantic anchors that facilitate sentence-level annotation independently of broader document contexts and enable systematic comparisons of claims across different sources.
Although scientific discourse exhibits comparable structures, previous research on SAM has paid relatively little attention to this anchoring strategy.
Building on recent advances in scientific entity extraction Jain et al. (2020) ; Otto et al. (2023) , we propose a novel approach to claim extraction from scholarly articles based on scientific entity anchoring.
In this approach, scientific entities (e.g., tasks, methods, and datasets) serve as structural anchors, playing a role analogous to that of “topics” in general-domain argument mining.
Anchoring arguments to scientific entities reformulates full-text SAM in two fundamental ways.
First, it reduces the scope of annotation to individual sentences, enabling claims to be identified and structured without requiring prior resolution of long-range discourse dependencies.
Second, it facilitates cross-document comparability by providing a common structural reference for claims concerning the same method and dataset, regardless of differences in their surface formulations.

blocks.zh: 图 1: 实体焦虑索赔提取管道。

blocks.en:
We present a pipeline for entity-anchored claim extraction from full-text scientific publications.
Rather than exhaustively annotating entire papers, we combine a carefully curated, independently human-annotated gold-standard dataset with a large-scale silver-standard dataset generated through consensus among three large language models (LLMs).
In a case study involving 50 research papers on sentiment analysis, we annotated 294 valid candidate sentences, identifying 113 claim-bearing sentences to establish a gold-standard dataset, which we subsequently used to validate a silver-standard dataset comprising 1,487 claims.
We demonstrate that encoders fine-tuned exclusively on the silver-standard dataset yield more stable claim identification than those trained on the smaller human-annotated gold-standard dataset or on data generated by a single LLM.
Furthermore, encoders trained on the silver-standard dataset demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization to NLP papers outside the case study corpus. Figure 1 provides an overview of the complete pipeline.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Full-Text Scientific Argument Mining
blocks.zh: 2.1 全文科学论证开采

blocks.en:
Teufel (1999) introduced Argumentative Zoning (AZ) to classify sentences in scholarly articles by rhetorical function, such as background, aim, and contrast. Teufel and Moens (2002) implemented AZ using hand-crafted features and Naive Bayes classifiers, while subsequent extensions captured domain-specific rhetorical functions in chemistry (AZ-II) ( Teufel et al., 2009 ) and biology ( Mizuta et al., 2006 ) .
Similarly, Liakata et al. (2012) introduced the Core Scientific Concepts (CoreSC) scheme to classify sentences in full-text biochemistry articles into 11 categories using SVMs and CRFs, while Fisas et al. (2016) developed the Dr. Inventor corpus to annotate discourse structure and novelty in computer graphics papers.
While rhetorical zoning captures the discourse structure of scholarly articles, identifying fine-grained argumentative components, particularly claims and supporting evidence, requires more specialized annotation schemes. Blake (2010) introduced a rule-based framework for distinguishing explicit, implicit, and comparative claims.
Building on the Dr. Inventor corpus, Lauscher et al. (2018) introduced Sci-Arg, extending its annotations with argumentative components ( Own Claim , Background Claim , Data ).
Following this line of work, we adopt Own Claim and Reported Claim as the primary argumentative components in our schema.

blocks.en: 2.2 Scientific Argument Mining using LLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2 利用LLMS进行科学论证采矿

blocks.en:
Binder et al. (2022) proposed a BERT-based pipeline for full-text argument mining, highlighting challenges in identifying non-contiguous argumentative units and their relations.
Although LLMs offer extended context windows that may help address these limitations, their application to scientific argument mining has primarily focused on claim verification and evidence-based reasoning.
Specifically, benchmarks such as SciFact-Open ( Wadden et al., 2022 ) and SciTab ( Lu et al., 2023 ) evaluate scientific claim verification against large literature collections and evidence from scientific tables, respectively.
Related approaches extend to peer-review analysis, assessing the evidential support for claims in reviews ( Guo et al., 2023 ) and linking reviewer feedback to subsequent manuscript revisions ( D’Arcy et al., 2024 ) .
More recently, benchmarks such as CLAIM-BENCH ( Javaji et al., 2025 ) and CLAIMCHECK ( Ou et al., 2025 ) have evaluated LLMs on scientific claim-evidence reasoning and the grounding of peer-review critiques in scholarly articles, respectively.
Thus, while LLMs are increasingly used to verify and critique previously identified scientific claims, their potential for entity-anchored claim extraction from full-text scholarly articles remains comparatively underexplored.
blocks.zh:
Binder等人(2022年)提议采用基于BERT的管道来进行全文论证开采,突出了在确定非毗连论证单位及其关系方面的挑战.
虽然LLMS提供了可帮助解决这些局限性的扩展上下文窗口,但它们在科学论证挖掘中的应用主要侧重于索赔的核实和基于证据的推理.
具体而言,SciFact-Open(Wadden等,2022年)和SciTab(Lu等,2023年)等基准分别对大型文献采集和从科学表格中获取的证据进行科学索赔核实。
相关办法延伸至同行审查分析,评估审查中对索赔的证据支持(Guo等人,2023年),并将审查者的反馈与随后的手稿修订联系起来(D ' Arcy等人,2024年)。
最近,索赔-BENCH(Javaji等人,2025年)和索赔CHECK(Ou等人,2025年)等基准分别对学术文章中关于科学索赔证据推理和同行评审批评的依据的法学硕士进行了评估。
因此,虽然LLMs越来越多地被用来核实和批评以前确定的科学主张,但是它们从全文学术文章中提取实体引起的主张的潜力仍然比较不足。

blocks.en: 2.3 Entity-Anchored Scientific Information Extraction
blocks.zh: 2.3 实体-安克雷德科学信息提取

blocks.en:
Scientific entity extraction has evolved from broad terminology extraction Luan (2019) to fine-grained annotation schemes covering tasks, datasets, and metrics (TDMSci) Hou et al. (2021) , machine learning models and architectures (GSAP-NER) Otto et al. (2023) , and subsequently to the extraction of relations between scientific entities (SciER) Zhang et al. (2024) .
In parallel, argument mining has increasingly incorporated topic-based approaches that anchor arguments to specific subjects of debate Irani et al. (2024) .
Building on these advances, MetaLead Timmer et al. (2026) introduces a richer annotation scheme linking tasks, training and test datasets, metrics, scores, and experiment types to support transparent comparisons of experimental results across scientific publications.
Structured scientific knowledge increasingly supports advanced tasks such as research idea generation. For example, SciMON Wang et al. (2024) leverages scientific concepts and prior literature to generate and iteratively refine novel research ideas.
While these extraction strategies have primarily served structured knowledge organisation or idea generation, their integration into full-text SAM remains limited.
We address this gap by using fine-grained scientific entities as explicit anchors for claim extraction.

科学实体提取从广义术语提取Luan (2019年)演变为涵盖任务、数据集和计量的精细注释计划(TDMSci) 许等. (2021),机器学习模式和架构(GSAP-NER). Otto等人(2023年),以及科学实体之间关系的提取(SciER) 张等 (2024).
与此同时,采掘论点越来越多地采用基于专题的办法,将论点置于辩论的具体主题之上。
在取得这些进展的基础上,MetaLead Timmer等人(2026年)推出了一个更丰富的注释计划,将任务、培训和测试数据集、衡量标准、分数和实验类型联系起来,以支持对各种科学出版物的实验结果进行透明的比较。
结构化科学知识日益支持研究思想生成等先进任务. 例如,Scimon 王等编. (2024)利用科学概念和前作文献产生并迭代地完善了小说研究思想.
虽然这些取出战略主要服务于结构化的知识组织或思想生成,但它们融入全文SAM仍然有限.
我们利用精细科学实体作为索赔提取的明确锚地来弥补这一差距。

blocks.en: 3 Entity-Anchored Claim Extraction
blocks.zh: 3 实体-安克雷德索赔

blocks.en:
We introduce Entity-Anchored Claim Extraction as the task of extracting claim structures from scholarly articles by anchoring them to scientific entities.
Traditional approaches to SAM often treat every sentence or phrase as a potential claim Teufel (1999) ; Lauscher et al. (2018) .
In contrast, our approach focuses exclusively on sentences containing explicit mentions of scientific entities.
We define an entity-anchored claim as a contestable and verifiable assertion about one or more scientific entities (e.g., tasks, datasets, metrics, or methods).
A sentence qualifies as claim-bearing if it makes an assertion about an entity’s performance, capabilities, limitations, comparative advantages, or intrinsic properties, among others.
blocks.zh:
我们提出实体 -- -- 安克雷德索赔提取公司作为从学术文章中提取索赔结构的任务,将其定位到科学实体。
对SAM的传统做法往往把每一句或每一句当作一种潜在的索赔Teufel(1999年);Lauscher等人(2018年)。
相反,我们的做法只注重明确提及科学实体的句子。
我们把实体提出的主张定义为对一个或多个科学实体(例如任务、数据集、衡量标准或方法)的可竞争和可核实的主张。
如果某一句对某一实体的绩效、能力、局限性、比较优势或内在性质等作出断言,则该句就有资格成为主张。

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Figure 2 , we represent each claim as a relational tuple in which scientific entities assume explicit roles (e.g., subject or object) linked by a predefined predicate.
Specifically, our controlled predicate inventory comprises four categories:
performance comparisons ( outperforms , underperforms , is-comparable-to ), performance changes ( improves , degrades , achieves ), applicability and transfer ( generalizes-to , fails-on , is-suited-for , is-standard-for ), and dependencies and efficiency ( requires , is-more-efficient-than ).
An additional OTHER label covers assertions outside this taxonomy.
We provide detailed predicate definitions and argument constraints in Table 8 in the appendix.
Furthermore, following established argument mining schemes Teufel (1999) ; Lauscher et al. (2018) , we distinguish Own Claims , concerning the authors’ work, from Reported Claims , attributed to prior research.
blocks.zh:
如图2所说明的,我们把每项主张作为一种关系性拖拉,科学实体在其中承担由预先定义的上游联系的明确作用(如主体或物体)。
具体而言,我们的受控上游清单包括四个类别:
性能对比(性能优异,性能不足,是-可比较的),性能变化(改进,降解,实现),可适用性和转移(通向,失败,是适合的,是-标准的),依赖性和效率(要求,是-更高效的).
其他标签包括本分类法以外的主张。
我们在附录表8中提供了详细的上游定义和论据限制。
此外,根据既定的采矿计划Teufel(1999年);Lauscher等人(2018年),我们将关于提交人工作的Own Claims与属于以前研究的《报告索赔》区分开来。

blocks.en: 4 Case Study: Sentiment Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 案例研究:判刑分析

blocks.en:
This case study evaluates the effectiveness of our entity-anchored approach to claim extraction from scholarly articles.
We investigate whether this approach enables standardized claim representations that lays foundation for the identification of implicit argumentative relations across scholarly articles beyond those captured by citation-based analysis.
This evaluation requires a corpus of densely interconnected scientific publications.
We therefore focus on sentiment analysis, a well-established research area in NLP with an extensive citation network.
blocks.zh:
本案例研究评估了我们实体所操纵的从学术文章中提取资料的方法的有效性。
我们调查这种做法是否使标准索赔陈述成为可能,为确定学术文章之间的隐含辩证关系奠定基础,而不是根据引用分析得到的。
这项评价需要一系列紧密相联的科学出版物。
因此,我们把重点放在情绪分析上,这是NLP中一个已建立的研究领域,拥有广泛的引用网络.

blocks.en: 4.1 Corpus Construction
blocks.zh: 4.1 公司建筑

blocks.en:
To construct a densely interconnected corpus of sentiment analysis papers, we seeded our search with three foundational benchmark publications: IMDb Maas et al. (2011) , SST Socher et al. (2013) , and SemEval-14 ABSA Pontiki et al. (2014) .
Using OpenAlex Priem et al. (2022) , we retrieved papers citing these benchmarks and filtered them by domain-specific keywords and open-access availability.
To ensure dense conceptual connectivity, we represented the retrieved papers as a graph, connecting papers through direct citations or shared scientific entities drawn from a curated list of datasets and methods.
Using community detection Clauset et al. (2004) , we identified a densely connected cluster of 209 papers.
From this community, we selected 50 papers using stratified sampling by publication year to ensure temporal diversity.
We parsed the documents using GROBID GROBID contributors (2008) .
Our preprocessing pipeline preserves all in-text citations (2,274 author-year spans), which serve as essential anchors for identifying Reported Claims .
We provide further details on document retrieval, community detection, and text normalization in Appendix A .

为了构建一套紧密相联的情感分析文件,我们以三项基本基准出版物作为搜索的基础: 互联网电影数据库(IMDb)上"Maas等"的资料(英文) (2011), SST Socher等(2013),以及SemEval-14 ABSA Pontiki等(2014).
我们利用OpenAlex Priem等人(2022年)检索了引用这些基准的论文,并用特定域的关键词和开放存取的可用性对其进行过滤。
为了确保密集的概念连通性,我们把检索的文件作为图表,通过直接引用或共享从数据集和方法清单中抽取的科学实体来连接文件。
利用社区检测 Cacretet等人(2004年),我们确定了一个紧密相连的209个文件组。
我们从这个社区中挑选了50篇论文,根据出版年份分级抽样,以确保时间多样性。
我们用GROBID GROBID 的投稿人(2008年)来解析文件。
我们的预处理程序保留了所有文字引用(作者年限为2 274个),这些引文是确定已报告索赔的重要依据。
我们在附录A中提供了关于文件检索、社区探测和文本正常化的进一步细节。

blocks.en: 4.2 Scientific Entity Extraction
blocks.zh: 4.2 科学实体采掘业

blocks.en:
To anchor claims within our corpus, we first require robust extraction of scientific entity mentions.
We utilize GSAP-NER Otto et al. (2023) , which provides a fine-grained taxonomy specifically tailored to machine learning models, datasets, and tasks.
Following the original architecture, we train two SciDeBERTa-CS taggers Jeong and Kim (2022) , one for specific entity types and one for generic references, on the complete set of 100 GSAP-NER publications.
blocks.zh:
我们首先需要从科学实体中 找到证据
我们利用GSAP -NER Otto等 (2023),它提供了一种精细的分类学,专门针对机器学习模型,数据集和任务.
按照最初的架构,我们培训了两个SciDeBERTa-CS标记器Jeong和Kim(2022年),一个用于特定实体类型,一个用于通用参考,关于100种GSAP-NER出版物的完整集.

blocks.en:
For our 50-paper corpus, we retain entity mentions from six categories: Task , Dataset , Datasource , Method , MLModel , and ModelArchitecture .
We exclude generic mentions and URLs but retain citation markers ( ReferenceLink ) to link reported claims to cited publications.
Our analysis shows that 59.3% of body-text sentences contain at least one scientific entity, providing a substantial candidate pool for entity-anchored claim extraction.
We provide extraction metrics, post-processing rules, and corpus-level entity statistics in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
对于我们的50份文件,我们保留了六个类别中的实体: 任务、 数据集、 数据源、 方法、 MLModel 和 ModelArchitecture 。
我们排除了通用的提及和URL,但保留了引用标记(ReferenceLink),将报告的说法与被引用的出版物联系起来。
我们的分析表明,59.3%的体文句子至少包含一个科学实体,为实体焦虑的索赔提取提供了大量的候选集合。
我们在附录B中提供提取指标、处理后规则和实体一级的统计数据。

blocks.en: 4.3 Annotation Details
blocks.zh: 4.3 注释细节

blocks.en:
Four expert annotators (two doctoral candidates and two postdoctoral researchers), all specializing in computational linguistics, conducted the annotation.
We sampled a subset of 300 entity-anchored sentences for the claim detection task.
To balance workload distribution and enable reliable inter-annotator agreement (IAA) estimation, we assigned 120 instances to each annotator.
All four annotators independently annotated a shared set of 60 instances, which we used to compute IAA.
To ensure reproducibility, we sampled instances using a fixed random seed ( 20260819 )
and developed a dedicated annotation tool ( Appendix C ) to support the process.
blocks.zh:
4名专家注释员(2名博士生和2名博士后研究人员)都专门从事计算语言学的研究,进行注释.
我们抽取了300个实体的句子 用于索赔侦测任务
为了平衡工作量的分配并促成可靠的公证员协议(IAA)的估计,我们给每个注释员分配了120个实例。
所有四个注释员都独立地注释了一套共有的60个实例,我们用来计算IAA.
为了确保可复制性,我们使用固定随机种子抽样实例(20260819)
并开发了专门的注解工具(附录C)以支持这一进程。

blocks.en:
Before the main annotation phase, we conducted a pilot study involving seven papers to familiarize annotators with the annotation scheme and tool.
From the remaining 43 papers, we identified 4,171 eligible candidate sentences, each containing at least one scientific entity mention in the body text.
We stratified the sampling by document structure and selected 300 sentences.
Specifically, we oversampled sentences from the abstract, conclusion, and results sections.
Conversely, we undersampled sentences from the introduction, related work, and methodology sections, which often contain procedural descriptions, standard definitions, and generic contribution statements that fall outside our claim definition.
blocks.zh:
在主要注释阶段之前,我们进行了一项试点研究,涉及七篇论文,使注释者熟悉注释计划和工具。
从其余43篇论文中,我们确定了4 171个符合资格的候选句子,每个句子中至少有一个科学实体在正文中提及。
我们按文件结构对取样进行分级,并选定了300句。
具体地说,我们从抽象、结论和结果部分对句子进行了过多的抽样。
相反,我们从导言、有关工作和方法章节中抽取了一些句子,这些章节往往载有不属于我们索赔定义的程序说明、标准定义和一般性贡献说明。

blocks.en:
The annotation process proceeds in two stages.
First, annotators determine whether the target sentence contains a claim.
If the sentence contains a claim, annotators classify it as either own_claim or reported_claim .
Second, annotators structure each claim by identifying its subject and object and selecting a predicate from a predefined inventory of 13 predicates (see Appendix C ).
For reported claims, annotators additionally link each claim to its corresponding citation marker.
blocks.zh:
注释过程分两个阶段进行。
首先,注释者确定目标句是否包含索赔.
如果该句包含一项索赔,注释者将其归类为自有索赔或已报告的自有索赔。
其次,注释者通过确定其标的和标的以及从预先确定的13个上游清单中选择一个上游(见附录C)来对每项索赔进行结构化。
对于所报索赔,注释员将每项索赔与相应的引号联系起来。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en:
Although entity-anchored claim extraction reduces annotation effort, it still requires considerable time and domain expertise.
To reduce this annotation burden, we investigate automated entity-anchored claim extraction using zero-shot LLMs and fine-tuned pretrained encoders.
blocks.zh:
虽然实体索赔提取减少了注解工作,但仍需要大量时间和领域的专门知识。
为了减轻这种注解负担,我们利用零发LLMs和微调的预先训练的编码器来调查自动实体安控索赔提取.

blocks.en: 5.1 LLM-Based Extraction Pipeline
blocks.zh: 5.1 基于LLM的取出管道

blocks.en:
We benchmark three LLMs: Qwen3.6-27B, Gemma-4-31B-it, and Mistral-Small-3.2-24B.
To ensure comparability, we use a common prompt template across all models, iteratively refined using Qwen3.6-27B.
We extract claims in three passes:
blocks.zh:
我们以三个LLM为基准:Qune3.6-27B、Gemma-4-31B-it和Mistral-Small-3.2-24B。
为确保可比性,我们使用所有模型的通用即时模板,使用Qune3.6-27B进行迭代改进。
我们通过三条路获取索赔:

blocks.en:
1. Document Profiling (Paper Card): The LLM processes the title, abstract, introduction, section headings, and conclusion to generate a paper card summarizing the paper’s major claims, proposed methods, tasks, datasets, and core contributions. 2. Sentence-Level Extraction: The model processes target sentences in the context of their full sections to facilitate anaphora resolution.
The LLM determines whether a sentence contains a claim and, if so, extracts its subject, object, and predicate according to our manual annotation scheme. 3. Rule-Based Coreference: A deterministic post-processing step replaces generic self-references (e.g., “we” , “our model” ) with the explicit method name extracted from the paper card.

1. 联合国 文档剖析(纸卡) : LLM处理标题、抽象、导言、章节标题和结论,以生成一张纸卡,概述纸的主要主张、建议的方法、任务、数据集和核心贡献。 2. 判刑级采掘: 模型处理的句子在其完整章节中设定了目标,以便于解答阿法拉.
LLM确定一个句子是否包含一个权利要求,如果包含,则根据我们的人工注释方案提取其主体,对象和上游. 3. 基于规则 引用 : 确定后处理步骤用从纸卡上取出的明确方法名称来取而代之的是通用的自我参照(例如“我们”、“我们的模型”等)。

blocks.en:
Sentence-Level Extraction: The model processes target sentences in the context of their full sections to facilitate anaphora resolution.
The LLM determines whether a sentence contains a claim and, if so, extracts its subject, object, and predicate according to our manual annotation scheme.

句子级提取 : 该模型在全文章节中针对句子进行处理,以利解答Aaphora.
LLM决定一个句子是否包含一个权利要求,如果包含,则根据我们的人工注释方案来提取其主体,对象和上游.

blocks.zh: 规则参照: 确定后处理步骤用从纸卡上取出的明确方法名称来取而代之的是通用的自我参照(例如“我们”、“我们的模型”等)。

blocks.en: 5.2 Fine Tuning via Silver Data
blocks.zh: 5.2 通过银色数据进行精细调试

blocks.en:
While our zero-shot LLM pipeline identifies claims, we further investigate whether smaller, specialized encoders can achieve comparable performance more efficiently.
To this end, we aggregated sentence-level claim predictions from all three LLMs across the 50-paper corpus.
Using majority voting, we constructed a silver-standard dataset for claim identification from the three LLMs’ predictions.
We then fine-tuned two pretrained masked language models, SciBERT Beltagy et al. (2019) and DeBERTa-v3-large He et al. (2021a) ; He et al. (2021b) , with sequence classification heads using this dataset.
We employ five-fold cross-validation at the paper level, fine-tuning a separate model in each fold on silver-standard sentences from the training papers and evaluating it on gold-standard sentences from held-out papers.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们的零发LLM输油管确定了索赔,但我们进一步调查较小的、专门化的编码器是否能够更有效地实现可比较的性能。
为此,我们汇总了50多份文件中所有三个LLMs的句子级索赔预测。
我们利用多数投票,从三个LLMs的预测中构建了一套银相标准数据集,用于确认索赔要求。
随后,我们调整了两个经过预先培训的口罩语言模型,SciBERT Beltagy等人(2019年)和DeBERTa-v3-group He等(2021a年); He等 (2021b),序列分类头使用此数据集.
我们在纸面上采用五倍的交叉验证,从训练论文中精炼出银标准句子的每叠中一个单独的模型,从被搁置的论文中用金标准句子来评价.

blocks.en: 5.3 External Validation on ClaimFlow
blocks.zh: 5.3 索赔的外部审定

blocks.en:
To determine whether our entity-anchored claim extraction strategy generalizes beyond our initial case study, we sought an external dataset for validation.
Existing full-text argument mining corpora are either relatively dated Teufel (1999) ; Teufel et al. (2009) or focus on domains outside NLP Mizuta et al. (2006) ; Blake (2010) ; Liakata et al. (2012) ; Lauscher et al. (2018) , limiting their suitability for evaluating our scientific entity extraction model.
Recent resources also provide full-text claim annotations, including CLAIM-BENCH Javaji et al. (2025) , which links scientific claims to supporting evidence, and ClaimFlow Pramanick et al. (2026) , which traces claims and their relationships across NLP publications.
We select ClaimFlow for its scale, NLP domain coverage, and sentence-level annotations, which align with our annotation granularity.
ClaimFlow identifies central claims in NLP papers, focusing on their abstracts, introductions, and conclusions.
The dataset provides paraphrased claims alongside supporting evidence sentences from the source text.
We use ClaimFlow claims to evaluate our fine-tuned encoder models.
blocks.zh:
为了确定我们实体操纵的索赔提取战略是否超出我们最初的案例研究,我们寻求外部数据集进行验证。
现存的全文论证公司或为Teufel(1999年);Teufel等人(2009年),或侧重于NLP Mizuta等人(2006年);Blake(2010年);Liakata等人(2012年);Lauscher等人(2018年),限制了它们是否适合评估我们的科学实体提取模型。
最近的资源还提供了索赔说明的全文,包括将科学索赔与佐证联系起来的索赔-BENCH Javaji等人(2025年)和跟踪索赔及其在NLP出版物中的关系的索赔-Flow Pramanick等人(2026年)。
我们选择 ClaimFlow 来表示它的规模, NLP 域覆盖度, 以及句子级别的说明, 这与我们的注释颗粒性一致。
ClaimFlow在NLP文件中指明了中心索赔,重点是其摘要、导言和结论。
数据集提供了解释性索赔以及来源文本中的佐证句子。
我们用ClaimFlow的主张来评估我们微调的编码器模型.

blocks.en: 6 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 6 结果和讨论

blocks.en:
We present the results of our annotation study and evaluate the performance of LLMs and fine-tuned encoders.
Unless otherwise specified, we report 95% confidence intervals (CIs) for all annotation and model evaluation results, using 10,000 bootstrap resamples.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍我们注释研究的结果,并评估LLMs和微调编码器的性能。
除非另有说明,否则我们报告95%的置信间隔(CIs)用于所有注释和模型评价结果,使用一万个靴子套件。

blocks.en: 6.1 Annotation Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.1 注释分析

blocks.en:
We evaluate inter-annotator agreement for claim detection on 60 core sentences.
Excluding the annotator who worked on annotation guidelines, the three independent annotators achieved a reliable Krippendorff’s α \alpha of 0.80 (95% CI: 0.66-0.92).
Across the full dataset of 300 sentences we use annotation from all four annotators.
Out of 300, 6 sentences were discarded as unusable, 113 (38.4%) were identified as claims, predominantly concentrated in the results sections and beyond.
For the claim structure extraction, annotators produced 199 records across 113 distinct gold claim sentences, heavily anchored on scientific entities for both subjects (90.5%) and objects (66.3%).
Annotators agreed on the number of claims per sentence in 93% of shared cases. However, agreement was moderate for subjects ( α = 0.64 \alpha=0.64 , 95% CI: 0.46–0.78) and objects ( α = 0.65 \alpha=0.65 , 95% CI: 0.45–0.81), but low for predicates ( α = 0.46 \alpha=0.46 , 95% CI: 0.23–0.66).
blocks.zh:
我们评价60个核心句子的 公证员之间的协议
除了负责注释准则的注释员之外,三个独立的注释员还实现了可靠的Krippendorff的α-α(95%的CI:0.66-0.92).
在300个句子的完整数据集中, 我们使用所有四个注释器的注释。
在300个判决中,有6个判决因无法使用而被放弃,113个(38.4%)被确定为索赔,主要集中于成果部分及以后。
就索赔结构提取而言,注释者在113个不同的黄金索赔判决中提供了199个记录,主要依靠科学实体处理(90.5%)和物体(66.3%)。
在93%的共有案件中,注释者商定了每句索赔的数目。 然而,对主题(α=0.64\alpha=0.64, 95%CI:0.46–0.78)和对象(α=0.65\alpha=0.65, 95%CI:0.45–0.81)的协议是中度的,但对于上位数(α=0.46\alpha=0.46, 95%CI:0.23–0.66)的协议较低.

blocks.en:
Disagreement in subject and object annotations primarily arose from different interpretations of complex, multi-claim sentences.
Additionally, subject mismatches frequently resulted from differing preferences in entity span granularity (e.g., selecting simply PBAN versus the more expansive PBAN + fine-grained + bidirectional attention ).
Conversely, the majority of predicate disagreements (56%) were driven by the OTHER class.
For example, given the sentence “syntactic target information derived from parses complements well with the left-target-right context representation” , one annotator selected OTHER (specifying complements ), while the remaining two attempted to utilize the predefined taxonomy, selecting is-suited-for and is-comparable-to , respectively.
Overall, outperforms (24%) and achieves (22%) were the most frequent predicates, while negative or limiting predicates accounted for only 11%.
Additionally, 95% of claim records were classified as own_claim .
blocks.zh:
对主题和对象说明的分歧主要来自对复杂、多索赔句的不同解释。
此外,主题不匹配常常是由于实体间颗粒度的偏好不同(例如,只选择PBAN,而选择范围较广的PBAN+精细加双向注意)。
相反,大多数上游分歧(56%)是由其他类别驱动的。
例如,鉴于句子“从剖面中获取的协同目标信息与左-右上下文表述互补良好”,一名注释员选择了其他(具体说明补充),而其余两人则试图利用预先定义的分类法,分别选择适合和比较。
总的来说,业绩(24%)和成绩(22%)是最常出现的上游,而负或有限度的上游仅占11%。
此外,95%的索赔记录被归类为自有索赔。

blocks.zh: 图3:对照多数人标签评价的60个核心句子的表现。 Whiskers表示95%的靴子圈 CI,而灰色曲线表示恒定F1轮廓. 开放圈(A1–A3)显示个别注释员同意反对其他两个的多数.

blocks.en: 6.2 Model Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6.2 示范评价

blocks.en:
We evaluated the three LLMs and their majority-vote ensemble, denoted as maj3 , on both the 60 shared sentences ( Figure 3 ) and the full 294-sentence gold-standard set ( Table 1 ).
On the core subset, maj3 achieved the highest F1 score (0.889) among the LLMs and showed strong agreement with the majority human annotation ( κ = 0.82 \kappa=0.82 ), comparable to that of the least-consistent annotator with the other two ( κ = 0.81 \kappa=0.81 ).
On the full gold-standard set, maj3 achieved the highest agreement ( κ = 0.78 \kappa=0.78 ) and F1 score (0.864) among the LLMs, although its F1 score was statistically indistinguishable from Gemma’s and significantly higher only than Qwen’s.
Overall, all models tended to identify more claims per sentence than human annotators, resulting in lower precision.
Despite moderate human agreement on claim structure, we evaluated the generated structures against gold-standard annotations for all correctly identified claim-bearing sentences.
Qwen achieved the highest F1 scores for all three structural components: subjects (0.79), predicates (0.60), and objects (0.55).
Mistral followed with F1 scores of 0.74, 0.53, and 0.47, respectively, while Gemma performed worst (0.71, 0.51, and 0.43).
blocks.zh:
在60个共同句子(图3)和全部294个判决金本位标准(表1)上,我们评价了3个LLM及其多数投票组合,表示为maj3。
在核心子集上,maj3在LLMs中取得了最高的F1分(0.889分)并表现出强烈的认同大多数人类注释(ob = 0.82\kappa= 0.82分),与其他两个注释(ob = 0.81\kappa= 0.81分)最不相符合的注释者相当.
在全金标准集中,maj3在LLMs中取得了最高的一致(=0.78\kappa=0.78)和F1分(0.864),尽管其F1分在统计学上与Gemma分不相上下,并且只明显地高于Quen分.
总体而言,所有模型都倾向于确定比人类注释员更多的每句索赔,导致准确度较低.
尽管人们在索赔结构上达成了温和的协议,但我们对照黄金标准说明对所有正确确定的索赔判决进行了评估。
Quen在所有三个结构组成部分都取得了最高的F1分:主体(0.79分),上游(0.60分)和对象(0.55分).
米斯特拉尔跟随,F1的得分分别为0.74分,0.53分和0.47分,而Gemma表现最差(0.71分,0.51分和0.43分).

blocks.en:
Given the strong performance of maj3 , we applied it to all 9,073 sentences in our 50-paper corpus, yielding a silver-standard dataset comprising 1,487 claims ( Table 2 ).
These sentences include all annotated entities (generic or specific) and indicate whether a specific entity occurs in either of the two preceding sentences.
We train BERT-based encoders on this silver-standard dataset and evaluate them against the smaller human-annotated gold-standard dataset ( Table 1 ).
Averaged over three random seeds, DeBERTa-v3-large achieves an F1 score of 0.877 ( ± \pm 0.008), slightly exceeding SciBERT (0.865 ± \pm 0.014), although the difference is not statistically significant.
Its performance also does not differ significantly from that of the individual LLMs or the teacher ensemble, maj3 .
Despite the small gold-standard evaluation set, these results suggest that a 0.4B-parameter encoder can approximate the performance of an ensemble of three 24–31B-parameter LLMs on claim identification at substantially lower inference cost.
blocks.zh:
鉴于maj3的出色表现,我们在50个文件目录中将它应用于所有9,073个判决,产生了一个包含1,487项索赔的银标准数据集(表2)。
这些句子包括了所有注解的实体(普通或特有),并表明在前两句中是否有一具体实体发生.
我们根据银-标准数据集培训基于BERT的编码器,并根据较小的人类附加说明的金-标准数据集进行评估(表1)。
平均超过3个随机种子,DeBERTa-v3-group的F1得分为0.877分(±\pm 0.008分),略高于SciBERT(0.865±\pm 0.014分),虽然其差异在统计学上并不显著.
其表现也与个别LLMS或教师综艺节目"maj3"没有太大差异.
尽管黄金标准评价包很小,但这些结果表明,一个0.4B参数编码器可以以低得多的推论费用,大致显示三套24-31B参数LLMs的性能。

blocks.en: 6.3 Error Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.3 错误分析

blocks.en:
All three LLMs jointly missed only 2 of the 113 gold-standard claims and jointly misclassified only 2 of the 181 non-claims, allowing majority voting to mitigate model-specific errors.
Qwen, the most conservative model ( Figure 3 ), showed substantially lower recall for claims in abstracts and conclusions (0.42) than for those in results and subsequent sections (0.76). Relying on Qwen alone could therefore lead to underrepresentation of authors’ main findings.
In contrast, DeBERTa shows high agreement with its teacher ensemble, maj3 , matching its predictions on 272 of the 294 gold-standard sentences.
Of the 30 sentences misclassified by maj3 , DeBERTa corrects 13, primarily procedural or factual statements incorrectly classified as claims by Gemma and Mistral, while introducing only 9 new errors among the 264 sentences correctly classified by maj3 .
On the 60 core sentences, DeBERTa achieves perfect agreement with the annotator majority ( κ = 1.00 \kappa=1.00 ), compared with κ = 0.81 \kappa=0.81 – 1.00 1.00 (mean: 0.89) for individual annotators against the majority of their peers.
Finally, the encoder appears to inherit its teacher’s section-specific biases, achieving higher recall in results and subsequent sections (0.89) than in abstracts and conclusions (0.62).
blocks.zh:
这三个LLMs共同只错过了113个黄金标准索赔中的2个,并共同错误地将181个非索赔中的2个错误分类,使得多数投票可以减轻模式特有错误.
最保守的模型Quen(图3)显示,摘要和结论中的索赔召回(0.42)大大低于结果和随后各节中的索赔召回(0.76)。 因此,仅依靠Quen就会导致提交人的主要调查结果代表性不足。
DeBERTA表示,
在被maj3错误分类的30个句子中,DeBERTa更正了13个,主要是程序或事实陈述错误地归类为Gemma和Mistral的索赔,同时在被maj3正确分类的264个句子中只引入了9个新的错误.
在60个核心句子上,DeBERTa与注释者多数(ob = 1.00\kappa = 1.00)达成完美的协议,而针对多数同龄人的个人注释者则与0.81\kappa = 0.81– 1.00 (指:0.89).
最后,编码器似乎继承了教师在一节中特有的偏差,在结果和随后各节(0.89)中比摘要和结论(0.62)中实现更高的召回。

blocks.en: 6.4 Out of Corpus Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6.4 公司评价

blocks.en:
To assess cross-corpus generalization, we evaluate our DeBERTa model, fine-tuned exclusively on silver-standard data, on a preview version of ClaimFlow ( Pramanick et al., 2026 ) without additional training.
The dataset contains 1,365 human-annotated central claims (1-5 per paper) and their corresponding evidence sentences from 388 ACL Anthology papers.
While ClaimFlow does not require claims to be entity-anchored, we observe substantial overlap: 91.7% of its claims contain at least one task, dataset, or method entity in either their summary or evidence (rising to 98.6% when generic mentions are included).
Furthermore, entities are highly indicative of evidence sentences; 77% of ClaimFlow’s evidence sentences contain an entity, compared to only 63% of unselected sentences in the same sections.
When evaluated zero-shot, our model flags 53.6% of ClaimFlow’s evidence sentences as claims.
Because a single claim can be supported by multiple evidence sentences, the model successfully identifies 62.3% of the central claims via at least one evidence sentence, a figure that increases to 70.4% when evaluated alongside the claim summary text.

该数据集收录了1,365起人类附加说明的中央索赔(每份文件1至5起),以及388份ACL人类学论文中的相应证据句子.

此外,实体在很大程度上表明了证据判决;在ClaimFlow的证据判决中,有77%包含一个实体,而在同一章节中,只有63%的未选定判决。

blocks.en:
Our model identifies claims in 24.1% of entity-bearing sentences and 14.0% of sentences without entity mentions that ClaimFlow did not label as claim-bearing.
Because ClaimFlow is restricted to a few central claims per paper, measuring strict precision against its labels is not meaningful.
To interpret the discrepancies, a human annotator performed a blind manual review of 100 sentences: 50 false positives, and 50 false negatives.
Among the false positives, 78% (95% CI: 64%-87%) are genuine claims under our guidelines. 1 1 1 Sentences mixing a claim with a contribution statement were labeled as claims; excluding these reduces the rate to 73%. Conversely, of the false negatives, only 6% (95% CI: 2%–17%) qualify as claims under our schema.
The vast majority of these misses are contribution statements (e.g., “we propose …”, 20 of 47) or procedural descriptions (17 of 47), which our guidelines intentionally exclude.
Therefore, the divergence between the datasets reflects a difference in definitions rather than model error.
ClaimFlow identifies a paper’s central claims, whereas our model extracts an exhaustive set of entity-anchored, evaluative claims.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: 7.1 Does entity anchoring make claim annotation focused and reliable?
blocks.zh: 第7.1条 实体锚地是否作出重点突出和可靠的索赔说明?

blocks.en:
In general, every sentence in a scholarly paper can be considered as an assertion.
For example, in Sci-Arg, full-text annotation produced an average of 205 claim spans per paper Lauscher et al. (2018) .
However, entity anchoring reframes the annotation objective from a vague is this a claim? to a specific does this sentence make a contestable assertion about this entity? This constraint significantly reduces the search space, as only 59% of body sentences in our corpus contain scientific entities.
It also maintains strictness, filtering out 62% of these candidate sentences as non-claims to yield a manageable average of 32 claims per paper.
More importantly, this localized focus enables highly reproducible annotations ( α = 0.80 \alpha=0.80 ).
Furthermore, the likelihood of a sentence constituting a claim increases with entity density (31%, 37%, and 51% for one, two, and ≥ \geq 3 entities, respectively), indicating that entities act as strong signals of argumentative content rather than arbitrary filters.
Although this approach inherently bounds the scope of extractable claims (see Limitations), it successfully transforms open-ended full-text annotation into a focused, reliable sentence-level decision.
blocks.zh:
一般来说,学术论文中的每一个句子都可以被认为是一种断言.
例如,在Sci-Arg案中,全文注释平均每份文件Lauscher等人(2018年)产生205项索赔。
然而,实体锚定从含糊不清的角度重新界定注解目标是否是一种主张? 这句话是否对这一实体提出了有争议的断言? 这种限制大大地缩小了搜索空间,因为我们案卷中只有59%的身体判决包含科学实体.
它还保持严格,过滤了62%的这些候选判决,作为非索赔,平均每份文件可管理地得出32项索赔。
更重要的是,这种地方性重点能够产生高度可复制的说明(α=0.80\α=0.80)。
此外,构成索赔的判刑的可能性随着实体密度的提高而增加(一个、两个实体分别为31%、37%和51%),这表明实体充当有争议内容的强烈信号,而不是任意过滤器。
虽然这种方法内在地限制了可提取债权的范围(见"限制"),但是它成功地将无限制的全文注释转化为重点明确,可靠的句子级决定.

blocks.en: 7.2 Can LLMs Replace Costly Full-Text Annotation?
blocks.zh: 7.2 LLMs能够以成本方式取代全文说明吗?

blocks.en:
While entity anchoring reduces the annotation search space, manual full-text labeling remains impractical.
Relying on a single LLM is also prone to errors due to varying model strictness and biases.
However, as noted in the previous section, using an ensemble of models largely offsets these biases because their mistakes rarely coincide.
Consequently, our majority-vote ensemble ( maj3 ) achieved strong human agreement ( κ = 0.78 \kappa=0.78 on gold , κ = 0.82 \kappa=0.82 on core ).
We further validated this by training encoders on individual LLM outputs versus maj3 .
Encoders trained on single-LLM outputs inherited their respective teacher’s bias (Gemma: P 0.78 / R 0.95; Qwen: P 0.95 / R 0.71) and scored lower (F1 0.853 and 0.812) relative to the maj3 -trained DeBERTa (0.877).
Furthermore, training encoders exclusively on our small human-annotated gold set via 5-fold cross-validation produced weaker and less stable models (F1: 0.812 ± \pm 0.019).
Therefore, the LLM-generated silver data provides a highly scalable alternative that yields a stable encoder performance.

依靠单一的LLM也容易出错,因为模型严格性和偏差不同.
然而,如上一节所指出,使用一套模型在很大程度上抵消了这些偏差,因为其错误很少重合。
因此,我们的多数选票组合(maj3)达成了强有力的人类协议(=0.78\kappa=0.78) 在黄金上, = 0.82\ kappa= 0.82 在核心上。
我们进一步验证了这一点,对编码员进行了关于个人LLM产出与maj3结果的培训。
接受过单-LLM输出培训的编码员继承了各自教师的偏好(Gemma:P 0.78 / R 0.95;Quen:P 0.95 / R 0.71)并得分较低(F1 0.853和0.812),而Maj3-trained DeBERTa(0.877)。

因此,LLM生成的银相数据提供了一个高度可扩展的替代品,可以产生稳定的编码器性能.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced entity-anchored claim extraction , an approach for extracting structured claims from full-text scholarly articles.
By utilizing scientific entity mentions as anchors, our approach replaces fuzzy, document-level discourse modeling with well-defined, sentence-local claim extraction.
We validated our methodology through a case study of 50 sentiment analysis papers published between 2013 and 2023.
Our rigorous annotation pipeline yielded a reliable human gold standard of 113 claim sentences, which we used to validate a large-scale silver dataset of 1,487 claims generated via a majority-vote LLM ensemble.
We demonstrated that encoders fine-tuned exclusively on our silver-standard dataset achieve more consistent claim identification performance than those trained on the smaller human-annotated gold-standard datasets or single-LLM-generated data.
These models also demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization to NLP papers outside the training corpus.
blocks.zh:
我们从全文学术文章中提取结构化索赔。
通过利用科学实体作为锚点,我们的方法用定义明确、句子明确的当地权利主张取而代之的是模糊、文件层面的讨论模式。
我们通过2013至2023年间发表的50份情绪分析论文的案例研究,验证了我们的方法。
我们严格的注解管道产生了113个索赔判决的可靠的人类金本位,我们用来验证通过多数投票产生的1 487项索赔的大规模银本位数据集。
我们证明,仅用银 -- -- 标准数据集进行微调的编码器,比用较小的人力附加说明的金 -- -- 标准数据集或单LLM生成的数据培训的编码器,能取得更一致的索赔确认性能。
这些模型还显示出在培训大纲之外对NLP论文的强烈零射通俗化.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
We acknowledge several limitations in our current study.
First, our extraction pipeline relies exclusively on the GSAP-NER model, incorporating alternative or more exhaustive scientific entity recognition frameworks could potentially alter recall profiles.
Second, our primary empirical validation is constrained to a densely linked case study of 50 sentiment analysis papers.
Although our zero-shot experiments on the ClaimFlow dataset demonstrate generalizability across the broader NLP domain, the framework remains to be evaluated across more diverse scientific disciplines.
Fundamentally, we recognize an inherent limitation of the entity-anchored paradigm: not every scientific argumentative component explicitly contains a typed scientific entity.
Consequently, our methodology does not guarantee an exhaustive extraction of all argumentative units within a publication.
However, our primary objective is not exhaustive recall, but rather to drastically reduce the manual effort required to structure full-text arguments.
Furthermore, our structured schema partially mitigates this restriction by capturing non-entity-bearing evidence within optional fields, such as the rationale .
Finally, the restriction to a 50-paper corpus was a deliberate choice to facilitate the dense, high-quality manual annotation of interlinked papers.
Building on this foundation, our ongoing future work aims to model the complete argumentative graph, encompassing complex intra-document and cross-document relations.
blocks.zh:
我们承认我们目前研究中存在一些局限性。
首先,我们的开采管道完全依赖全球战略应用方案 -- -- NER模式,纳入替代或更详尽的科学实体识别框架可能会改变召回情况。
第二,我们的主要经验性鉴定受限于对50份情绪分析论文进行密切关联的案例研究。
尽管我们在ClaimFlow数据集上的零镜头实验表明,在更广泛的NLP领域可以通用,但该框架仍有待在更加多样化的科学学科中进行评估。
从根本上说,我们认识到实体-受制约的范式的内在限制:并不是每个科学论证部分都明确包含一个被打字的科学实体。
因此,我们的方法不能保证在出版物中详尽地取出所有论证单位。
然而,我们的首要目标不是详尽无遗的回顾,而是大幅度减少为组织全文辩论所需的人工努力。
此外,我们的结构化计划通过收集非实体证据,如理由,部分地减轻了这一限制。
最后,对50份文件加以限制是有意选择,以便利对相互关联的文件进行密集、高质量的人工说明。
在这个基础上,我们今后正在进行的工作旨在建立完整的论证性图表模型,包括复杂的文件和跨文件关系。

blocks.en: 9 Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 9 道德考虑

blocks.en: Our annotations are released under a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license, whereas quoted text fragments retain the original open access or publisher licenses of the respective venues (ACL Anthology, AAAI, ICWSM, IJCAI) for research use. Since transformer based models or LLMs can produce errors, automated claims should serve as assistive tools rather than definitive replacements for reading the original papers. LLM-generated silver labels may also inherit latent model biases. Compute requirements were minimal, limited to inference with three open-weight LLMs on a single GPU node and fine tuning lightweight encoders.
blocks.zh: 我们的说明是根据一份CC BY-NC-SA 4.0许可证发布的,而所引用的文本片段保留了各自地点(ACL Anthology、AAAI、ICWMSM、IJCAI)的原始开放访问或出版许可证,供研究使用。 由于以变压器为基础的模型或LLMS可以产生出错误,所以自动化索赔应作为辅助工具,而不是阅读原始论文的确定替代. LLM生成的银色标签也可能继承潜在的模型偏差. 计算要求是最低限度的,仅限于在单一的GPU节点上用三个开口的LLMs推论和微调轻量级编码器.

blocks.en: In our graph construction, an entity edge was formed if two papers shared at least two keyword entities (from a curated list of 16 datasets and 21 methods shown in Table 3 ), with at least one being a dataset. Using greedy modularity maximization (implemented via NetworkX), we selected the largest community, comprising 209 papers. To select the final 50 papers, we ranked them first by within-community citation edges, then by entity edges. We stratified the selection across four publication year bands: 2014 and before, 2015-2017, 2018-2020, and 2021+, targeting 12-13 papers per band. As the 2014 and before band contained only 8 papers, we backfilled by rank, resulting in 17 papers for 2015–2017 and 13 for 2018-2020. More information about the select 50 papers are shown in Table 4 .

blocks.en: Following GROBID (v0.8.2) extraction, we applied localized text normalization. Specifically, we corrected hyphenation introduced by line breaks (e.g., “inter- nal” → \rightarrow “internal”) only when bounded by lowercase letters, deliberately preserving acronym compounds (e.g., “RAM- training”). We also repaired artifact hyphens stemming from PDF extraction errors (e.g., “Contex-tAVG” → \rightarrow “ContextAVG”) and recurring tokenization splits (e.g., “sof tmax” → \rightarrow “softmax”). Space formatting prior to punctuation was also standardized.
blocks.zh: 在GROBID(v0.8.2)取出后,我们实行了局部文本正常化。 具体地说,我们只用小写字母来校正由换行符引入的连字符(例如“内部内线” ),故意保留缩写(例如“RAM-训练”)。 我们还修复了由PDF提取错误(例如“Contex-tAVG”-和右侧“ContextAVG”)和反复出现的象征性分化(例如“sof tmax”-和右侧“softmax”)产生的文物连字符。 标出前的空间格式也实现了标准化。

blocks.en:
We developed a custom, lightweight web-based tool (Flask/SQLite) for blind annotation.
To provide necessary context without overwhelming the reader, candidate sentences are presented in reading order embedded within a local context window (two preceding and two succeeding sentences), alongside the paper title and section heading.
Distribution of stratified sampling of the sections for final annotation is shown in Table 7 .
To assist with structuring, automatically extracted scientific entities are highlighted in distinct colors by type, while generic entities (resolvable via the surrounding context) are underlined.

为了提供必要的背景,而不压倒读者,备选句子以阅读顺序嵌入到一个本地上下文窗口(前两句和后两句),与纸张标题和章节标题并列。

blocks.en: The annotation process proceeds in two steps:
blocks.zh: 注释过程分两个步骤进行:

blocks.en: • Identification: Annotators classify the target sentence as argumentative ( claim ) or non-argumentative ( non-claim ). A Cannot Judge option is provided to gracefully handle and exclude garbled text resulting from PDF extraction errors or instances lacking sufficient context. • Structuring: For identified claims, annotators specify the claim type ( Own or Reported ) and assign Subject and Object arguments by clicking the highlighted entities. blocks.en: For experimental reproducibility, we detail our computational setup and hyperparameters. Entity extraction via the GSAP-NER tagger was executed on a single NVIDIA RTX 4060 Ti (16GB VRAM) utilizing CUDA 13, Python 3.13, PyTorch 2.13, and Transformers 5.14. For silver data generation via LLMs, we deployed Qwen3.6-27B utilizing vLLM 0.17.1, alongside Mistral-Small-3.2-24B and Gemma-4-31B-it utilizing vLLM 0.29.0, hosted on an NVIDIA H200 NVL (141GB) node. Inference utilized OpenAI-compatible chat completions with prompts formulated as a single user message, employing greedy decoding (temperature 0), a 2,048 maximum token limit, a 16,000 maximum context length ( max_model_len ), and with internal thinking modes strictly disabled. Finally, the encoder fine-tuning was performed on an NVIDIA L40S GPU. We run 5-fold cross-validation split by paper. The 43 papers that contain human-annotated sentences are divided into five folds balanced by annotated-sentence count (8-9 papers, nearly 60 sentences per fold). The remaining 7 papers are always used for training. In each fold, the model is trained on silver labels (majority vote of three LLMs) from the other papers, with 10% of them (4 papers) held out as a development set for early stopping. It is evaluated on the human labels of the held-out fold. No paper appears in more than one of train, dev and test, and no human-annotated sentence is used in training, even with a silver label. We optimized the models using AdamW for a maximum of 5 epochs with a batch size of 32, a maximum sequence length of 128, a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , a weight decay of 0.01, a 10% linear warmup schedule, and a gradient clipping norm of 1.0. Training was regulated via early stopping based on the development set positive-class F1 score, utilizing a patience of 2 epochs and restoring the best-performing weights.
